convert_kandinsky_prior: run the Kandinsky prior checkpoint conversion script to convert a prior model to diffusers format
convert_kandinsky_text2img: run the Kandinsky text2img checkpoint conversion script to convert a UNet model to diffusers format
convert_kandinsky_inpaint: run the Kandinsky inpaint text2img checkpoint conversion script to convert an inpainting UNet to diffusers format
convert_kandinsky_decoder: run the Kandinsky movq checkpoint conversion script to convert a VQ decoder model to diffusers format
convert_kandinsky_split_attentions: run the split_attentions function to split combined QKV attention weights into separate query key and value tensors
